body:
Root cause confirmed via the real GitHub Actions job log: sdkmanager itself succeeded, but yes got a real SIGPIPE once sdkmanager stopped reading stdin, and set -o pipefail reported that as the whole step's failure. Fixed with a scoped set +o pipefail around the yes | sdkmanager line in both CI jobs. Reproduced and confirmed the exact failure/fix locally first.

⚓ ☃
title: CI fix: yes|sdkmanager pipefail bug was killing every build
